title: Go Go Masked Justice Rangers!

themes.title: Champion balance
themes.description: 6 champion buffs, 5 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: Go Go Masked Justice Rangers! Structured changes across 25 entities this patch.
